description: REMAX Europe lets users search live REMAX property listings across 25 European countries and browse the results in an interactive, image-rich gallery without leaving the chat. Users ask in plain language, a city or country, a budget, sale or rental, residential or commercial, minimum size or rooms, elevator access, and get up to 100 matching listings with photos, prices, and key facts, sortable by price or size and viewable in any of 32 languages. Tapping a listing opens a full detail view with a photo carousel, description (with on-demand translation), agent contact, and a link to the full page on remax.eu.

defaultPrompt: Find apartments for sale in Vienna under 500,000 euros
